name: Helm of Telepathy

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Detect Thoughts
powers.text: Cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 13) at will.

powers.name: Suggestion
powers.text: Once per dawn, cast Suggestion (save DC 13) on a creature you're in contact with.

summary: Detect Thoughts at will, telepathy, and a daily Suggestion (save DC 13).
text: While wearing this helm, you have the following benefits: you can cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 13) from the helm at will; while you maintain Concentration on the spell, you can take a Bonus Action to send a telepathic message to a creature you are focused on, and it can reply; and while focusing on a creature with Detect Thoughts, you can cast Suggestion (save DC 13) from the helm on that creature. Once used, the Suggestion property can't be used again until the next dawn.
